scope: Local Oathbound bear study; original assets preserved.
frontPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D animation sprite atlas for Crownforge: Oathbound, a fantasy game.
Primary request: create a beautiful hand-drawn brown grizzly bear animation sheet with the bold forms, warm painted pixel shading, crisp dark contours and expressive key poses of premium 1990s arcade action games. Original artwork.
Input image: reference image only for the bear's identity: massive shoulder hump, chestnut brown fur, golden muzzle, dark paws, rounded ears. Improve the anatomy and personality; replace photographic fur with clean authored clusters and readable shadows.
Layout is CRITICAL: exactly 4 equal columns and 5 equal rows, 20 separate full-body bear drawings, transparent background, no labels, no grid lines. Tall canvas 2048x2560. Each cell 512x512. Every pose fits entirely inside its cell with at least 35px clear padding. Same bear size in every frame, locked camera, locked scale. Ground/contact baseline at 450px within every cell, body center at x=256. No painted ground shadow.
View: three-quarter FRONT view facing screen RIGHT throughout all 20 frames. Head near right, rump left, see face and broad left flank. Low isometric camera about 15 degrees above horizontal. Every drawing has exactly FOUR anatomically correct limbs.
Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
Row1: 4 subtle idle breathing poses, inhale/chest rise/exhale/settle, firmly planted paws.
Row2: first 4 consecutive keyframes of an 8-frame powerful running lope. Contact, compression, push-off, gathering legs. Clear changing leg silhouettes, front and rear limbs articulate naturally.
Row3: final 4 consecutive keyframes of the SAME running cycle: opposite contact, compression, push-off, gathering. Frame8 loops perfectly to frame1. Keep shoulder bounce restrained.
Row4: 4 consecutive claw attack frames: lower body and pull near paw back in anticipation; shoulder pivots and paw raised; sweeping powerful forward claw swipe with open snarl; recover paw to ground. Distinct strong silhouettes, no magical effect.
Row5: 4 consecutive collapse frames: flinch head recoils; forelegs buckle; rolls onto flank; completely resting on side at ground level with eyes closed. No blood, no gore.
Frames should animate coherently without morphing or changing size. Detailed readable chestnut fur tufts, cream-brown muzzle, expressive small amber eyes, powerful real bear anatomy. Avoid cute teddy bear proportions, avoid smooth 3D renders, avoid extra limbs, avoid any text. Actual transparent alpha background.
